The '''Eighteenth Battalion''' was a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], commanded by clone [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Herc]] and Jedi general [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]].<ref name="TCW" />
